Service 01

Agent Team Development

We design, build, and deploy custom multi-agent teams tailored to your workflows. From a Finance Analyst team that produces reports in 4 minutes, to an HR pipeline that screens 200 CVs overnight — we deliver production-ready agent teams on Agentivity.

What you get

  • Requirements workshop & workflow mapping
  • Agent design: roles, prompts, tools, topology
  • Build & test on your infrastructure
  • Documentation + handover session
  • 30-day post-launch support
Enquire →
Service 02

IT Transformation

We help organisations migrate from manual, fragmented processes to AI-orchestrated operations. That means auditing your current stack, identifying where agent teams create the highest value, and delivering a phased roadmap — from first pilot to org-wide deployment.

What you get

  • AI readiness audit (people, processes, data)
  • Prioritised opportunity matrix
  • Pilot team delivery (1 high-impact workflow)
  • Phased rollout plan across departments
  • KPI definition & measurement framework
Enquire →
Service 03

AI Architecture & Strategy

Before you build, you need the right design. We architect your AI stack end-to-end: model selection (open vs proprietary), topology choice (Sequential, Group Chat, Concurrent), data flows, memory strategy, security boundaries, and cost optimisation. No lock-in, no over-engineering.

What you get

  • AI stack design document
  • Model & provider recommendations
  • Agent topology design per use case
  • Data privacy & compliance mapping
  • Cost model & BYOK strategy
Enquire →
Service 04

Custom Model Training

General-purpose LLMs aren't always enough. We fine-tune and train specialised models on your domain data — legal, medical, financial, technical — so your agents perform with the precision of an expert, not a generalist. Smaller, faster, cheaper, and deeply adapted to your vocabulary and processes.

What you get

  • Dataset audit & curation
  • Base model selection (open-weight or proprietary)
  • Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or RLHF pipeline
  • Evaluation benchmarks on your domain
  • Deployment on your infrastructure (BYOK-compatible)
Enquire →
Service 05

Integration & Deployment

Agentivity doesn't live in a vacuum. We connect your agent teams to your existing stack — CRMs, ERPs, data warehouses, internal APIs, Slack, email — so your agents act on real data and deliver results where your team already works. Docker, on-premise, or private cloud.

What you get

  • Connector development (REST, webhooks, internal APIs)
  • Auth & secrets management
  • On-premise or private cloud deployment
  • CI/CD pipeline for agent team updates
  • Monitoring & alerting setup
Enquire →
Service 06

Workshops & Team Training

We teach your team to build, maintain, and scale agent teams themselves. Half-day to two-day formats, hands-on with Agentivity. From non-technical stakeholders learning to compose agents visually, to developers going deep on prompt engineering, topologies, and custom tooling.

What you get

  • Tailored curriculum for your team level
  • Hands-on sessions on Agentivity canvas
  • Prompt engineering best practices
  • Team topology design exercises
  • Workshop materials + recorded sessions
Enquire →

Engagement models

Choose the format that fits your project and budget.

Fixed scope

Defined deliverable, fixed price. Best for agent team builds and specific integrations where the scope is clear.

  • Clear specification upfront
  • Milestone-based payment
  • Full IP transfer on delivery
Most common

Retainer

Ongoing partnership — a fixed block of hours per month. Best for teams that want to iterate, expand, and evolve their AI capabilities continuously.

  • Dedicated team capacity
  • Priority response
  • Monthly review & planning

Workshop

Half-day to two-day intensive. Best for teams that want to learn to build with Agentivity themselves and get expert guidance on their specific use cases.

  • In-person or remote
  • Custom curriculum
  • Hands-on exercises
